summary: This configuration block uses Apache's FilesMatch directive to target two specific image files by their names and then blocks all access to them by denying requests from every client. It's a way to hide or protect those particular files from being served to anyone who requests them.

explanations.1: FilesMatch uses a regular expression (the pattern in parentheses) to match file names; the backslashes before the dots are escaping special regex characters so it matches literal dots, and the pipe | means 'or', so this targets either file_1.gif OR file_2.png.
explanations.2: Order Allow,Deny sets the sequence for processing access rules — it means 'first check Allow rules, then check Deny rules', making the final Deny directive take precedence.
explanations.3: Deny from all rejects requests from all clients, essentially blocking everyone from accessing the matched files.
